episodes.title: Coming Home
episodes.summary: Amy and Lou Fleming, and their grandfather Jack, deal with life after their mother's death while a new ranch hand, Ty Borden, comes to live and work at Heartland.

episodes.title: After the Storm
episodes.summary: Lou sends an uncured horse back to its owner, which causes friction with Amy. Ty builds Amy a jumping ring and Jack decides to keep Ty on at Heartland.

episodes.title: Breaking Free
episodes.summary: High profile horse breeder Lisa Stillman asks Amy to help her with her horse, Promise. Lou holds a Heartland Open House to help bring in business.

episodes.title: Taking Chances
episodes.summary: Ben Stillman arrives at Heartland and his treatment of his horse Red angers everyone. Ashley lures Ty to Briar Ridge with a job offer.

episodes.title: Best Laid Plans
episodes.summary: Lou decides to make a promotional video for Heartland. Ty's new job at Briar Ridge isn't going as planned. Scott gets Amy to help with a wild pony.

episodes.title: One Trick Pony
episodes.summary: Lou's boyfriend Carl arrives at Heartland with a couple of different proposals for Lou. His welcome, however, is both hot and cold.

episodes.title: Come What May
episodes.summary: Lou isn't pleased when a neighbouring rancher brings a pregnant mare named Melody to stay at Heartland. Ty is astonished when Jack asks him to join him on a cattle roundup.

episodes.title: Out of the Darkness
episodes.summary: The pressure is on when a famous race horse, Gallant Prince, is sent to Heartland to see if it can be rehabilitated.

episodes.title: Ghost from the Past
episodes.summary: An old girlfriend of Ty's shows up at Heartland and stirs up trouble. Lou is reunited with Sugarfoot, Mrs. Bell's miniature horse.

episodes.title: Born to Run
episodes.summary: Nick Harwell arrives to train Ben but becomes interested in buying Spartan. Mallory thinks Lou plans to re-home Copper and runs away with him, only to discover a plot to sell wild mustangs.

episodes.title: Thicker Than Water
episodes.summary: Tim's visit to Heartland causes sibling rivalry between Lou and Amy. Jack takes Lisa Stillman fishing on their second date.

episodes.title: Rising from the Ashes
episodes.summary: Scott invites Lou to a black tie dinner on the same night as the local high school's semi-formal. Ty accompanies Amy to the local dance leaving Jack home alone to mind the ranch. When an arsonist strikes, Jack is injured and can't recall exactly what happened. Will his memory recover in time to identify the culprit?

episodes.title: Coming Together
episodes.summary: Amy finds herself working with the enemy when Ashley asks for her help. Amy's also preparing Spartan for the Fall Finale while Lou decides what to do about a job offer in New York.

episodes.title: Ghost Horse
episodes.summary: Amy's secret birthday wish is fulfilled when Ty returns to Heartland, but she soon realizes she can't start over from where they left off.

episodes.title: Letting Go
episodes.summary: Ty can gain the trust of a wild horse, but can he regain Amy's trust?

episodes.title: Gift Horse
episodes.summary: Her father's gift forces Amy to make a difficult choice between a career in show jumping or her work at Heartland.

episodes.title: Dancing in the Dark
episodes.summary: As friends and neighbours gather to pay their respects at a memorial for Ray Philips, Tim secretly makes plans to buy Big River Ranch.

episodes.title: Corporate Cowgirls
episodes.summary: Lou doubts her choice to live and work at Heartland when a group of corporate career women arrives for a weekend retreat.

episodes.title: Holding Fast
episodes.summary: Out for a ride along the river, Amy comes across an RCMP officer desperately trying to save a young boy from drowning.

episodes.title: Sweetheart of the Rodeo
episodes.summary: With the annual Hudson Heritage Rodeo looming, everyone at Heartland gets roped into the action and intrigue of broncs, bulls, beer, beauty queens and belt buckles.

episodes.title: Summer's End
episodes.summary: In the middle of heat wave, a cattle truck loaded with thirsty and overheated horses pulls into Heartland. Ty can hardly believe his eyes when the driver turns out to be his dad.

episodes.title: Showdown!
episodes.summary: Tension reaches new heights when cattle rustlers hit Tim's Big River Ranch.

episodes.title: True Enough
episodes.summary: When Amy's not so favourite teacher Ms. Adams, brings a horse named Boxer to Heartland, Amy learns a valuable lesson about fathers and daughters.

episodes.title: Starstruck!
episodes.summary: When Hollywood comes to Heartland, Amy is so starstruck, she loses track of what's really important in her life.

episodes.title: Divorce Horse
episodes.summary: Lisa meddles into Lou's business and personal life with disastrous results.

episodes.title: Seismic Shifts
episodes.summary: Lou goes head to head with Big Alberta Oil when seismic surveyors force their way onto Heartland.

episodes.title: Do or Die
episodes.summary: Clint brings two tough kids on probation to Heartland forcing Ty to deal with a part of his past he'd rather forget.

episodes.title: Dark Horse
episodes.summary: Lou resurrects the Hudson Derby, stirring up an age-old grudge match between Jack and Tim.

episodes.title: The Ties That Bind
episodes.summary: Amy and Ty will stop at nothing to get Spartan back after he's stolen.

episodes.title: Full Circle
episodes.summary: Amy heads into the mountains to visit a First Nations horse healer named Victor Whitetail, and leaves with a new understanding about horses, her mom and herself.

episodes.title: Step by Step
episodes.summary: Ty and Amy are finally forced to deal with their feelings for each other after a snowstorm strands them at Jack's fishing cabin in the mountains.

episodes.title: Miracle
episodes.summary: Amy is thrust into the limelight when she performs a "miracle" on a traumatized horse and a video clip of the event is posted online.

episodes.title: Little Secrets
episodes.summary: Amy finds herself caught in the middle of a family crisis when she tries to help a girl and her horse recover from what appears to be a freak accident.

episodes.title: Man's Best Friend
episodes.summary: Jack's truck is on its way to rust bucket heaven, forcing him to find the courage to say goodbye to a part of his past.

episodes.title: The Haunting of Hanley Barn
episodes.summary: Amy and Ty spend the night in the "haunted" Hanley barn, trying to get to the bottom of a mystery.

episodes.title: Glory Days
episodes.summary: Tim and Jack are reliving their glory days, and Amy begins to wonder if Ty is revisiting his past when he and Kit are thrown together dealing with her pregnant mare.

episodes.title: Growing Pains
episodes.summary: When Amy and Ty become the proud, new parents of an orphaned foal, the strength of their relationship is put to the test.

episodes.title: The Starting Gate
episodes.summary: When Tim buys a racehorse from Lisa, he puts everything on the line, including Amy, to win big.

episodes.title: The Fix
episodes.summary: Ty protects his mother Lily from his abusive stepfather, who shows up at Heartland to win her back.

episodes.title: Broken Arrow
episodes.summary: Amy is upset when Ty flies off with Scott to a remote vet call on his last day before heading to vet school.

episodes.title: Eye of the Wolf
episodes.summary: Amy leads a rescue search to find Ty and Scott, whose plane has gone missing in a remote forested mountain area.

episodes.title: Catch and Release
episodes.summary: While the boys head off on a fishing trip, the girls are left back at Heartland to deal with the havoc caused by a dog, a porcupine and a herd of escaped cows.

episodes.title: The Reckoning
episodes.summary: Victor Whitetail makes a surprise visit to Heartland, which stirs up the past and leaves Tim wondering if Victor was more than just friends with his ex-wife.

episodes.title: Quarantine
episodes.summary: When a dangerous horse disease called Strangles puts Heartland under quarantine relationships are put to the test and Pegasus becomes very ill.

episodes.title: The Happy List
episodes.summary: Amy and Ty are at odds over his purchase of a vintage motorcycle while Caleb goes off to a rodeo in Montana despite Ashley's growing concerns about his life on the circuit.

episodes.title: Second Chances
episodes.summary: Amy faces a tough moral dilemma when she discovers Mr. Hanley has abandoned his horses and is on the brink of losing his farm.

episodes.title: Spin Out
episodes.summary: Caleb struggles to get over the physical and emotional scars from his terrible accident as Amy tries to get him back on a horse and Tim doles out some tough love.

episodes.title: Ring of Fire
episodes.summary: When Amy follows in her mother's footsteps and enters a professional colt starting competition her gift with horses, and self-confidence, is put to the test.

episodes.title: In the Cards
episodes.summary: A surprise announcement by Peter throws Lou's wedding plans into disarray while Amy and Ty are forced to make difficult decisions about their futures.

episodes.title: Homecoming
episodes.summary: Amy tries to pretend that nothing has changed when Ty returns to Heartland with a surprise guest.

episodes.title: What Dreams May Become
episodes.summary: Amy scratches the surface to discover Nick Harwell's problems with his polo ponies, Lou's life in Dubai and Tim's relationship with his jockey are not what they appear to be.

episodes.title: Road Curves
episodes.summary: When an unspoken attraction re-surfaces, Amy discovers that honesty might be the best policy, but it certainly isn't the easiest one.

episodes.title: Graduation
episodes.summary: A looming high school graduation and Spartan's near fatal bout with colic force Amy to face where her future really lies.

episodes.title: Where the Truth Lies
episodes.summary: When Amy and Ty convince Sarah, the town recluse, to let them treat her sick horse at Heartland, the family helps her face the ghosts of her past.

episodes.title: Win, Place or Show
episodes.summary: Tim enlists Amy to ride Lightning Dexter in a big time stakes race when he finds out his girlfriend, Janice has teamed up with the competition.

episodes.title: Jackpot!
episodes.summary: Amy and Kit have to put their differences behind them when they take on Caleb in a team-roping jackpot.

episodes.title: One Day
episodes.summary: When Amy is hired to do a horse clinic with a group of inmates, Ty is surprised to discover one of them is a friend from his bad old days at the group home.

episodes.title: Local Hero
episodes.summary: When Ty and Amy find her father's stolen cattle, Tim convinces the family they need to take the law into their own hands.

episodes.title: Mood Swings
episodes.summary: Ty and Amy's relationship is put in jeopardy when Ty's travel buddies Grant and Blair return to Heartland.

episodes.title: Family Business
episodes.summary: Amy fights to keep Dexter in the family when she learns Tim is putting the horse up for sale in a claiming race.

episodes.title: Lost Song
episodes.summary: Jack is forced to revisit a rough patch in his marriage when he finds an unfinished song by Lyndy in her old guitar case.

episodes.title: The Road Home
episodes.summary: Ty has some tough decisions to make when Jack leaves him literally at a crossroads.

episodes.title: Leap of Faith
episodes.summary: Amy must deal with Stewart Forrest's unrealistic expectations when she works with his daughter and an elite jumper that may be too much horse for the girl to handle.

episodes.title: The River
episodes.summary: Lou helps Amy fight Stewart Forrest's bitter lawsuit to save her sister's reputation and the family business.

episodes.title: Never Surrender
episodes.summary: When a paralyzed military vet and ex-rodeo cowboy hires Amy to help sell his roping horse she sees an opportunity to re-train both horse and rider.

episodes.title: Burning Down the House
episodes.summary: A horse crazy young boy comes to Heartland and quickly bonds with Amy, but his mother has a secret that could change everything for the Fleming family.

episodes.title: Passages
episodes.summary: Amy and Ty work through their trust issues as they train a pair of Clydesdales, but it is an emergency at Heartland that reveals their true strength as a team when it matters most.

episodes.title: Finding Freedom
episodes.summary: Amy is inspired to take her horsemanship to a new level when she works with a professional liberty horse trainer.

episodes.title: Something in the Night
episodes.summary: When Tim is coerced to go with Jack on a secret mission Amy is left back at Heartland with Janice to get a young racehorse ready for his maiden run.

episodes.title: What's in a Name?
episodes.summary: When Tim reveals to the family that Shane is his son it throws everybody for a loop and threatens to ruin the traditional Bartlett-Fleming naming ceremony for Lou's baby!

episodes.title: Beyond Hell's Half Mile
episodes.summary: When Amy works with a chuck wagon horse she discovers an impediment that could put the entire team in danger & change the dynamics of a prominent chuck wagon family.

episodes.title: Never Let Go
episodes.summary: Amy helps to restore the confidence of a troubled, young trick-rider so that she can get back on her horse and perform again.

episodes.title: The Slippery Slope
episodes.summary: A friend from Jack's past shows up at Heartland when one of their old band mates passes away. Lou & Lisa secretly try to gather the other remaining members for a reunion performance to celebrate Jack's birthday.

episodes.title: Over the Rise
episodes.summary: When Shane arrives to stay for the summer, Tim tries to impress all three of his kids with a really cool Western day trip.

episodes.title: Nothing for Granted
episodes.summary: When Ty visits Mrs. Bell to thank her for paying his school fees he and Amy are surprised to learn she's moved out of her home, and away from Sugarfoot.

episodes.title: Cover Me
episodes.summary: When Tim's young racehorse Cisco is stolen on the way to his maiden race, Amy and Ty get help tracking him down from an unlikely source - Ty's step-father, Wade.

episodes.title: Trust
episodes.summary: When Amy bravely tries to heal an abused (and now extremely violent) racehorse Ty and Jack think she's finally bitten off more than she can chew.

episodes.title: Fool's Gold
episodes.summary: Ty's mother Lily returns to Heartland with shocking news about his father, and a secret that threatens her relationship with her son.

episodes.title: Road to Nowhere
episodes.summary: When Jack learns Ty is riding his bike solo to a remote lake to spread his father's ashes he decides to surprise Ty and join him for this meaningful road trip.

episodes.title: Aftermath
episodes.summary: In an attempt to avoid hitting a wolf, Ty is badly injured when he crashes his bike on a remote road, leaving Jack to search for help in the middle of nowhere.

episodes.title: Working on a Dream
episodes.summary: Amy is roped into helping Tim project a positive image to the community, in hopes it will further his custody case for Shane.

episodes.title: Breaking Down and Building Up
episodes.summary: When tragedy strikes Amy must find a way to save Mr. Hanley's rescue horses from kill buyers.

episodes.title: Wild Horses
episodes.summary: Amy and Ty join Scott on a trip back to his old reservation to save a herd of wild horses from the dangerous EHV-1 virus.

episodes.title: True Calling
episodes.summary: When Amy's dog Lobo is injured by a trigger-happy rancher, it's up to Ty to save his life.

episodes.title: Candles in the Wind
episodes.summary: When a mystery horse arrives at Heartland, Amy and Ty are sent down a path that will alter their lives.

episodes.title: Running Against the Wind
episodes.summary: Amy is bursting to ask Ty about the engagement ring, and why he hasn't proposed yet, but a couple of "runaways" throw everything at Heartland into turmoil.

episodes.title: Crossed Signals
episodes.summary: Ty struggles to deal with the fact that Amy has found the engagement ring and has to decide how and whether he is going to propose to her or not.

episodes.title: Keeping Up Appearances
episodes.summary: Tim hopes for a big commission when he helps a wealthy weekend cowboy look for his dream ranch, while Amy's stuck teaching his trophy wife how to ride.

episodes.title: The Natural
episodes.summary: Amy tries to fulfill Mallory's dream of being a show jumper but discovers that it's Georgie who has the natural talent.

episodes.title: Trial Run
episodes.summary: Janice brings Cisco Kid (and her emotional baggage over Tim) to Heartland for Amy to figure out why Cisco's lost that winning feeling.

episodes.title: Helping Hands
episodes.summary: Amy seeks out an up-and-coming show jumper (JEREMY) to learn why he's refusing Scott and Ty's suggested treatment for his horse.

episodes.title: Life is a Highway
episodes.summary: Chase Powers returns to Heartland with an aspiring "liberty horse" rider (Hayley) who wants Amy to be her coach. And Amy is shocked to learn what Hayley's connection is to Chase.

episodes.title: Do the Right Thing
episodes.summary: When Ty needs some engine parts for his broken down truck he's forced to turn to the last person on earth he wants help from - his stepfather, Wade.

episodes.title: Great Expectations
episodes.summary: A trip to help out an old friend at a fishing camp doesn't go as planned, and a series of unexpected events elevate it into a life-changing weekend for the entire family.

episodes.title: The Road Ahead
episodes.summary: Amy and Ty hold off telling the family their great news when they return from their trip to find everyone reeling from the devastating fire at Lou and Peter's home.

episodes.title: Blowing Smoke
episodes.summary: Jeremy forces Amy to make a tough decision about Phoenix when his horse, Buckingham, sustains a serious injury that threatens his jumping career.

episodes.title: Playing with Fire
episodes.summary: When a local horse show is cancelled Lou saves the day for Georgie and Mallory by stepping up to host it at Heartland.

episodes.title: Waiting for Tomorrow
episodes.summary: Scott discovers that Spartan has a broken leg and Amy is forced to make the toughest decision of her life.

episodes.title: Lost and Gone Forever
episodes.summary: Ty's future as a vet is in serious jeopardy when he's blamed for a shocking fatality at Scott's clinic.

episodes.title: After All We've Been Through
episodes.summary: To clear his own name, Ty searches for damning evidence to prove Jeremy was behind Buckingham's death.

episodes.title: Born to Buck
episodes.summary: Amy is having trouble dealing with a roping horse that only wants to buck and Caleb, who isn't sure he wants to ride broncs anymore.

episodes.title: Breaking Point
episodes.summary: Amy and Lou help Georgie regain her confidence as a showjumper when Olivia makes her question her place in the family.

episodes.title: Under Pressure
episodes.summary: With the threat of losing Phoenix looming over their heads, things become even more complicated at Heartland when Georgie gets a surprise visit from her brother Jeff.

episodes.title: Picking Up the Pieces
episodes.summary: As the family struggles to cope with recent changes at the ranch, Amy realizes she must reclaim her 'Miracle Girl' status and focus on her work with horses.

episodes.title: Living the Moment
episodes.summary: Amy and Ty find the ranch of their dreams, while Peter attempts to mediate when Georgie and Olivia come to blows.

episodes.title: Wrecking Ball
episodes.summary: Lou and Tim find themselves on opposite ends of a fight when Tim attempts to rebrand Maggie's into a soulless fast food franchise.

episodes.title: The Penny Drops
episodes.summary: As Amy and Ty work to help a mare and foal through a difficult weaning process, Mallory's discovery that Jake is planning to leave Hudson forces her to re-examine the choices she has made.

episodes.title: Thread the Needle
episodes.summary: Amy attempts to help a young RCMP constable overcome a personal challenge to fulfill his lifelong dream of performing in the RCMP Musical Ride.

episodes.title: Now or Never
episodes.summary: Georgie is enthralled when she sees one of Amy's clients trick riding and she's determined to pursue it despite Lou's misgivings.

episodes.title: Best Man
episodes.summary: When an old friend turns to Ty for help, Ty is torn between his ties to the past and his loyalties to his family at Heartland.

episodes.title: Hotshot
episodes.summary: When a family vacation is cancelled at the last minute, Jack and Georgie head off for a long-awaited fishing trip that lands them in a situation they hadn't bargained for.

episodes.title: There But for Fortune
episodes.summary: Amy's success working with a high-end show jumper ultimately puts her life in jeopardy.

episodes.title: Darkness and Light
episodes.summary: Family members are pitted against each other over Amy's medical treatment as she struggles to come to terms with her injuries and uncertain future.

episodes.title: Better Days
episodes.summary: Ty forces Amy to confront her fear and work with the horse that injured her in order to save its life.

episodes.title: Walking Tall
episodes.summary: When Ty brings a maltreated Tennessee Walker to Heartland to convalesce, Amy goes undercover in order to bring its abusers to justice.

episodes.title: Lost Highway
episodes.summary: Amy works with a horse to help it overcome its fear of water, but sparks fly when Jack learns the horse is owned by a former flame.

episodes.title: Things We Lost
episodes.summary: When a road trip goes awry Jack and Lisa find themselves lost in the woods, but a trip down memory lane may just help them find their way together.

episodes.title: Smoke ‘n' Mirrors
episodes.summary: Tim goes through a mid-life crisis and buys a hot horse instead of the more traditional hot car.

episodes.title: The Comeback Kid
episodes.summary: Amy's client list has dwindled to next to nothing since her accident, so the recently returned Lou convinces her to hold a "comeback" clinic to reboot her career.

episodes.title: On the Line
episodes.summary: Amy and Ty are at odds over Ty's risky investment in a barrel racing horse, and things become increasingly complicated when Amy starts working closely with Prince Ahmed.

episodes.title: Be Careful What You Wish For
episodes.summary: Amy works with Ty and Caleb's barrel racing horse and ends up riding him in a high-stakes Futurity.

episodes.title: There and Back Again
episodes.summary: Amy returns from Europe but finds herself struggling to integrate back into life at Heartland and her relationship with Ty.

episodes.title: The Big Red Wall
episodes.summary: After her initial shock at her grandfather's announcement, Lou throws herself into party planning mode and forces Jack into an awkward reunion with an old acquaintance. Ty becomes the middleman when Amy and Caleb butt heads over horse training. And still reeling from her recent discovery, Georgie pulls away from Amy and focuses on donating money to an online animal sanctuary

episodes.title: Severed Ties
episodes.summary: Amy's attempts to reunite with Georgie are continually thwarted by the arrival of lavish gifts from afar. When Tim is captivated by an old acquaintance, he and Jack team up for a charity event. Meanwhile, Lou and Peter disagree about potential pre-schools and Lou takes Katie for an assessment. And an unexpected revelation forces Ty to question his career prospects

episodes.title: Secrets and Lies
episodes.summary: A surprise visitor at Heartland makes an unwelcome declaration and Amy is forced to deal with the devastating consequences. Meanwhile, a dire animal crisis at the Reserve eerily parallels Ty's personal life when he realizes that some things just can't be saved. Still stinging from Katie's pre-school rejection, Lou's insistence that a specialist test her daughter brings an unexpected result. And Georgie realizes she needs her own trick riding horse in order to keep up with her nemesis Olivia

episodes.title: Endings and Beginnings
episodes.summary: Amy struggles to turn a pair of horses into a team, and is forced to go head-to-head with a rival trainer. Meanwhile, Ty discovers a dead bear on the Reserve with its gallbladder missing but when he begins asking too many questions, poachers threaten his life. When Ty asks Georgie to care for an orphan wolf pup, she sees it as an opportunity to reunite Amy and Ty. And Lou hires Jade to work at the Dude Ranch but quickly regrets her decision when the unpredictable teen proves to be a problem employee who takes advantage of the situation.

episodes.title: Steal Away
episodes.summary: Amy initially blames Georgie and Jade when a client horse repeatedly escapes from his stall, but she is forced to reevaluate when she discovers that the horse has hidden skills. Meanwhile, when his boss at the Reserve refuses to help him bring down a dangerous poaching ring, Ty is forced to turn to Scott for assistance. And Jack enlists Georgie's help to turn the reluctant Jade into a ranch hand.

episodes.title: Walk a Mile
episodes.summary: Amy struggles to help a Hutterite family whose team of Percherons ran amok hayride. But Georgie forms a strong bond with the young Hutterite daughter who turns out to be the key to unraveling the mystery. While Tim admittedly had a fantastic time traveling the rodeo circuit with Casey, he returns to Heartland and begins to second-guess their burgeoning relationship. Meanwhile, back at the clinic, a significant vet victory for Ty proves to be a bittersweet triumph when he realizes that all he wants to do – is share the experience with Amy. And Jack is forced to confront his traditional ideals when Lisa informs him that she has no intention of taking his name.

episodes.title: The Family Tree
episodes.summary: A school project opens a door to Georgie's past that could ultimately change her life at Heartland. Meanwhile, Casey expresses interest in buying one of Ty and Caleb's bulldogging horses and Caleb enlists Amy's help to train it in order to secure the deal. Then, while celebrating their first big sale, Ty tells Caleb that he wants to officially pull out of their business partnership, which results in Caleb forging an unlikely alliance. And Tim is forced to come clean about his senior rodeo circuit dreams when he learns that Casey is buying a bulldogging horse for him

episodes.title: The Pike River Cull
episodes.summary: When a threat of a cull looms over a herd of wild horses, Jack and Amy go to the aid of an old friend in Pike River.

episodes.title: The Heart of a River
episodes.summary: Amy and Ty find themselves drawing closer as they make a desperate bid to save the wild horses.

episodes.title: The Silent Partner
episodes.summary: Amy finds herself in a difficult position when a client reveals that Peter turned down a lucrative job offer in Calgary.

episodes.title: Broken Heartland
episodes.summary: When Amy is invited to do a horse clinic in Montana, she and Ty decide to take a road trip together, but an unexpected encounter derails their plans.

episodes.title: Cowgirls Don't Cry
episodes.summary: Tim opens a rodeo school, determined to help young people avoid injury while getting the training they need, but is immediately confronted with a problem student.

episodes.title: Riders on the Storm
episodes.summary: Amy and Ty help Scott's nephew realize he is worthy of continuing his family tradition of relay racing.

episodes.title: Eclipse of the Heart
episodes.summary: Lou returns from Vancouver with an admission that threatens to change the Heartland family forever.

episodes.title: Faking It
episodes.summary: The family strives to support a devastated Georgie when Lou and Peter are forced to tell her distressing news.

episodes.title: All I Need is You
episodes.summary: Lou spearheads preparations for the big day while Amy throws herself into gentling a rescue horse in order to avoid all the craziness.

episodes.title: Written in Stone
episodes.summary: In order to give Amy and Ty the wedding they really want, Lou struggles to deal with a slew of last minute hurdles.

episodes.title: Brave New World
episodes.summary: While a dangerous bear lurks near Heartland, Amy and Georgie rescue an injured horse from the woods.

episodes.title: Begin Again
episodes.summary: Ty prepares to celebrate an important milestone as he and Amy treat an abandoned horse.

episodes.title: Riding for a Fall
episodes.summary: After enlisting Amy to help her perfect a trick to perform at an upcoming rodeo, Georgie gets pulled away by Lou and Peter who insist she focus on her schoolwork.

episodes.title: Ties of the Earth
episodes.summary: Jack grapples with the impending loss of a loyal and trusted friend. And in a desperate bid to relieve Paint's arthritis and extend his life, Ty focuses on medical treatments while Amy uses every herbal and physical therapy she's learned. Meanwhile, Georgie deals with her new math tutor, a brilliant but arrogant boy from her school.

episodes.title: Back in the Saddle
episodes.summary: As Amy and Georgie prepare to compete in a cowboy competition, Georgie guilts Jack into helping her train on a new horse in the hopes he will fall in love with the animal.

episodes.title: Over and Out
episodes.summary: Ty and Amy's attempt to rescue an injured eagle in the mountains takes a dangerous turn. Georgie is thrilled to be volunteering at the Reserve for extra credit, until she is forced to pair up with her arrogant math tutor. Finding it difficult to juggle the demands on her time, Lou comes into conflict with Lisa over her busy schedule.

episodes.title: Fearless
episodes.summary: Amy helps a Medieval jouster who was badly injured during a competition regain his confidence so he can compete again. When Georgie aces her written driving test, Tim steps up to give her driving lessons. Meanwhile, Ty and Amy consider breaking up with Caleb and Cass after a disastrous double date. And Lou stresses over Katie's first day of kindergarten and her daughter's decision to "marry" a little kindergarten friend that soon leads to a "divorce.

episodes.title: Reckless Abandon
episodes.summary: Amy's attempts to help Georgie deal with an impending departure are complicated by Olivia.

episodes.title: A Matter of Trust
episodes.summary: Amy and Ty work together to determine why Caleb's horse becomes ill during his treatment at Heartland. Meanwhile, Georgie pits her parents against each other to get permission to go on an "away" trip with some girls from the Extreme Team. And while Jack and Tim work together to bring the loft up to code as ordered by the insurance inspector, they discover unexpected interlopers.

episodes.title: Darkness Before Dawn
episodes.summary: Georgie begins to second-guess her decision to run away from Heartland, while the family bands together to find her. Meanwhile, Amy and Ty work frantically to save Georgie's horse Phoenix from pesticide poisoning. And Jack, Tim and Caleb team up to trace the pesticide's origins.

episodes.title: Making the Grade
episodes.summary: Ty gets roped into helping Jack and Tim on a cattle drive but an unforeseen accident jeopardizes their plans. Meanwhile, Georgie must work with an unlikely ally to find a way out of a corn maze. And a girls' night in turns sour when Amy dispenses unwanted relationship advice to Lou.

episodes.title: The Real Deal
episodes.summary: Tim seeks Amy and Georgie's help to discourage Jade from accepting a shady sponsorship deal. And when one of Georgie's trick riding horses can't perform, Amy works with Cass to treat him using acupuncture. Meanwhile, the world of online dating brings out Lou's worst analytical side.

episodes.title: Risky Business
episodes.summary: Amy and Cassandra work together to save a racehorse with a career-ending condition, while the arrival of a former girlfriend - Janice - forces Tim to see his current relationship with Casey in a new light. Meanwhile, Georgie does a favour for Olivia and it completely backfires, threatening Adam's campaign for class president.

episodes.title: No Regrets
episodes.summary: Georgie's school project on Val Stanton inspires her to take a risk with Adam. Meanwhile, a shocking announcement from Caleb makes Ty question why Amy hasn't told him some important news. And Jack hires new help for Heartland after a close call puts several horses in danger.

episodes.title: Making a Move
episodes.summary: When Lou returns from New York she is forced to confront two interlopers: Heartland's new ranch hand, and a trendy food truck that is threatening Maggie's business. Meanwhile, Amy struggles to help a challenging client regain her confidence. Then, after Georgie insists that she and Adam are nothing more than "friends," she is devastated when she sees him at a party with another girl. And Tim makes a difficult decision about his future.

episodes.title: Pandora's Box
episodes.summary: Lou finds herself trapped at the Dude Ranch with Mitch, the new ranch hand, and they both reveal the circumstances of their recent pasts. While helping Amy treat a client horse, Ty feels conflicted about opening a mysterious package that has ties to his troubled past. And Jack and Lisa cope with a health scare, while Georgie and Adam deal with the fallout from Adam's kiss with another girl.

episodes.title: Love is Just a Word
episodes.summary: While trying to help Cass learn to handle a spirited horse, Amy discovers there is more riding on their success than she initially realized. Meanwhile, Tim insists the entire Heartland family attend a Hudson holiday party where Lou is forced to deal with a series of unexpected events, not the least of which is Peter's sudden appearance. When tragedy strikes at the Wildlife Reserve, Georgie risks her life to save a herd of miniature horses and Ty steps in to offer support when Bob's dream of expanding the Reserve goes up in smoke. Meanwhile, when Remi destroys his new fly- fishing bait supplies, Jack holds onto his grudge against the dog in order to win a bet with Lisa.

episodes.title: Resolutions
episodes.summary: When their plans to get away are thwarted, Amy and Ty celebrate their first anniversary closer to home and Amy unveils a special surprise. Meanwhile, Peter lobbies for a reunion forcing Lou to make a difficult decision about her and her family's future. While her parents grapple with their decision, Georgie has to act quickly on a trail ride when she learns a secret about Adam that leaves his life hanging in the balance. And Ty steps up to convince the devastated Bob to reconsider when he decides to throw in the towel at the Wildlife Reserve.

episodes.title: There Will Be Changes
episodes.summary: As Amy and Ty prepare for parenthood, they work together to resolve a dangerous pregnancy issue. Meanwhile, Georgie may be forced to give up something she loves when a demanding new Extreme Team coach arrives on the scene. Then, Lou has to decide whether she should tackle a new business venture that may take her away from the Heartland family. When Jack and Mitch work together with the herd, Tim is not ready to be pushed aside. And Georgie and Adam find the perfect way to celebrate an anniversary.

episodes.title: You Just Know
episodes.summary: Ty performs life-saving surgery on a mare, while Amy and the family work around- the-clock to bottle feed the mare's twin foals. Meanwhile, Georgie's new coach overhears Georgie confront Sam when she suspects her of sabotage during an Extreme Team practice, and Sam blames Georgie when she loses her headliner status. Forced together on a trail ride, Lou and Mitch come to terms with their mutual attraction and Lou reaches a decision about her future. Adam pushes Georgie to dig deep when she has to write an essay on her "most memorable moment." And when the goldfish Tim buys for Katie suddenly dies, Tim and Jack struggle with how to break the news to her.

episodes.title: New Kid in Town
episodes.summary: Tim is caught in the middle of Jade's showdown with a new hotshot bronc rider. Meanwhile, Georgie is feeling trapped in a rivalry of her own with Adam. Amy and Jack work with a top-flight bronc that has lost his mojo, while Ty faces a dilemma when a new professional passion project threatens to upend his life with Amy. And old feelings are rekindled when Casey enlists Tim's help with a new rodeo school student.

episodes.title: New Horizons
episodes.summary: When Amy and Ty reach a difficult decision about their future, the Heartland family grapples with the implications of their choice. Meanwhile, Georgie and Jade convince Tim to hire them to work at Maggie's, and Ty and Amy work together to save Casey's barrel racing horse.

episodes.title: Something to Prove
episodes.summary: When one of Tim's team-building events turns competitive, Georgie gets stuck partnering with Jade's cocky rival. Meanwhile, Amy and Cass have a falling out over Ty's partnership at the vet clinic until a close call forces them to reconcile. And Jack offers to help Tim with mounted orienteering in order to avoid lunch with Lisa's uppity aunt.

episodes.title: The Green-Eyed Monster
episodes.summary: When Amy helps a mounted archer reconnect with her horse, she also unravels the mystery behind Spartan's recent behavior. Meanwhile, Georgie is keen to tackle an exciting new challenge but her relationship with Adam is tested when he finds her spending time with another guy. Hoping they will finally have a chance to talk, Lou is surprised by Mitch's reaction when she unexpectedly descends on his solo fishing trip. And when Lisa accidentally throws out the key to his famous stew, Jack grows increasingly frustrated trying to recreate the recipe.

episodes.title: Riding Shotgun
episodes.summary: When Lou is given a horse, Amy helps her sister nurture a connection with the animal while Lou wrestles with the implications of the unexpected gift. Meanwhile, a crisis at the Wildlife Reserve brings Georgie and Adam together and provokes them to take a risk. And when Jack faces a deadly threat it prompts Mitch to come clean about his past.

episodes.title: Here and Now
episodes.summary: Fearing the worst, Jack is shocked to learn the reason for an old friend's unexpected visit to Heartland. Meanwhile, Amy intervenes when the new Extreme Team Coach pits Georgie and her teammates against each other. And Tim steps in when Jade's newfound status from a big sponsorship deal goes to her head and sends her down a dark path.

episodes.title: A Horse with No Rider
episodes.summary: An out-of-town horse clinic takes a dangerous turn for Amy, Tim and Georgie. Meanwhile, Lou's flight home is delayed and Jack is caught in the middle when Mitch's elevated status at Heartland begins to make Peter feel like an outsider. And when an endangered bear is shot by poachers Ty and Bob fight to save its life.

episodes.title: Together and Apart
episodes.summary: While Amy deals with a panicked horse trapped in a trailer, Georgie heads off on a desperate search for Tim. Meanwhile, Bob and Ty tackle a difficult surgery to save an endangered bear cub's life. When Amy, Tim and Georgie are late returning from a clinic, Jack and Mitch head off to find them. And with the help of Lou and his girls, Peter makes a choice that assures his place in the Heartland family.

episodes.title: Change of Course
episodes.summary: When Georgie unexpectedly struggles with a new challenge, Amy steps in to help her unearth the cause. Then, Amy's worst fears are realized when an eager Tim attends a pregnancy clinic with her. Meanwhile, Jack deals with an upset Katie when Lou's delayed return to Heartland forces him to navigate "back-to-school" prep. Feeling caught in the middle, Amy grapples with keeping a secret when Cass is convinced that Caleb is cheating on her. And Jade is surprised to see a new side of Clay when he stands up for his Aunt Casey.

episodes.title: Sound of Silence
episodes.summary: After tragedy strikes, Amy and Georgie work together to help Tim's traumatized barrel- racing horse. Meanwhile, Jack helps Tim, Casey, and the entire rodeo community pull through a devastating loss. And Jade gets her permit to compete in the pros but quickly gets pulled into the party lifestyle of that world.

episodes.title: Home Sweet Home
episodes.summary: When an unexpected guest arrives at Heartland, Amy and Jack question the real reason for the surprise visit. Meanwhile, Lou is upset to learn that her future plans with Mitch may be in jeopardy. Then, a confession by Adam leads Georgie to make a difficult decision. And Jack is caught in the middle when Lou and Lisa both buy the same gift for Amy's baby shower.

episodes.title: Written in the Stars
episodes.summary: Jake's unexpected arrival at Heartland forces Mallory to admit to Amy and Jack the real reason she came back to Heartland. Meanwhile, Georgie tries to move on after her break up with Adam by throwing herself into helping Amy with an underperforming cutting horse. And Lou and Mitch struggle to find the right time to tell the family about their relationship.

episodes.title: Forest for the Trees
episodes.summary: Amy struggles with the feeling that something is not right with Ty while she and Jack strive to help the ghost horse. Meanwhile, Georgie goes on a fun date with Clay's cousin, Wyatt, which leads her to a realization about Adam. And a concerned Tim steps up when Jade's plans fall through.

episodes.title: A Long Shot
episodes.summary: A secret from Jack's past threatens to change his relationship with the family forever. Meanwhile, Amy tries to uncover the connection between her new client and her reticent grandfather. While searching for Phoenix, Georgie comes clean about her true feelings for Adam. Forced to work together for the afternoon, Tim gives Mitch the gears when he learns of Lou and Mitch's relationship. And Ty grows increasingly ill as he attempts to get back to Amy.

episodes.title: Dreamer
episodes.summary: Amy and the family pull together as the gravely ill Ty returns home and is admitted to hospital. Meanwhile, Georgie discovers that Adam and Olivia are dating and must overcome her jealousy in order to help Olivia save Budget Buster's life. With Lou's franchise deal on the verge of collapse, she considers involving a controversial investor. And as Ty's health status continues to deteriorate, he faces an important choice.

episodes.title: Greater Expectations
episodes.summary: Amy, Ty and the entire Heartland family are thrilled to welcome a new member into the fold. Meanwhile, the ghost horse returns and Amy disagrees with Georgie's plan to capture and gentle him. Then, Lou changes her mind about a business deal but not before Mitch makes a surprising choice. And hoping to impress Cass's parents, Caleb asks a reluctant Tim for a full-time job.

episodes.title: Baby on Board
episodes.summary: Ty struggles with control issues when his mom stops by for an unexpected visit in hopes of bonding with her granddaughter, and Amy is forced to meditate. Meanwhile, Amy and Georgie work with a traumatized elite jumping horse and Georgie finds herself considering an amazing offer. Tim and Jack step in to help out when Ty makes a bad decision about a new truck.

episodes.title: Highs and Lows
episodes.summary: The family bands together to support Georgie as she decides whether to face a ghost from her past, or leave it behind.

episodes.title: Decision Time
episodes.summary: Tim steps up Jade's training regimen when a fierce new competitor shows her up at practice. Meanwhile, Georgie is faced with a difficult decision.

episodes.title: Hard to Say Goodbye
episodes.summary: Amy and Ty work together to prepare a wild horse for overseas transport, but the horse's temperament may be more than they bargained for. Meanwhile, with Georgie's first show just around the corner, the return of an old friend proves to be a distraction, and not for reasons you might suspect. Jack and Lisa clash as they discuss the next step in their relationship.

episodes.title: Measuring Up
episodes.summary: Lou returns from New York, only to find that things are not running as smoothly as she had imagined they would. Meanwhile, Tim is forced to do damage control when Caleb makes a mistake at the school.

episodes.title: Strange Bedfellows
episodes.summary: Amy has to get creative when asked to work with Lisa's racehorse, but conflict arises when information about the horse's breeding comes to light.

episodes.title: Our Sons and Daughters
episodes.summary: Amy tries to teach some old friends about the life-changing power of connecting to a horse.

episodes.title: Truth Be Told
episodes.summary: When Tim's erratic behavior sparks concern from his loved ones, Jack suspects something else is going on.

episodes.title: Challenges
episodes.summary: Amy tries to get everything organized at Heartland before joining Ty on a work-related journey, but Tim's concerns about the trip threaten to derail Amy's plans.

episodes.title: A Fine Balance
episodes.summary: Ty finds himself in a dangerous situation and in order to save him Amy must turn to an unexpected source for guidance.

episodes.title: Somewhere in Between
episodes.summary: Tim is forced to open up when an emergency traps him with an unexpected visitor.

episodes.title: Out of the Shadow
episodes.summary: Struggling with personal issues, Tim rallies the family to go on another memorial ride for Marion so he can face his deepest regret. Meanwhile, Georgie is forced to make a very difficult decision when Val questions Amy's ability to be her show jumping coach. Tim pushes Jade to accept a huge scholarship opportunity down in Texas, while Jack pushes Tim to finally be honest with Amy and Lou about his health issue.

episodes.title: Reunion
episodes.summary: As the family struggles to deal with Tim's news, Lou throws herself into planning her high school reunion to impress an old rival. Meanwhile, Amy tries to stay focused as Georgie comes up against an unexpected challenge while beginning to train with Phoenix. And Jack fights to control his own emotions as Mitch pressures him to discuss the future of the cattle business with Tim.

episodes.title: Past Imperfect
episodes.summary: A threat from Ty's past arrives in Hudson, putting the entire Heartland family in danger. Meanwhile, in the wake of an unexpected romantic encounter, Lou struggles with insecurities about her failed relationships, and Georgie worries about Adam's reaction when she tells him about her new status with Wyatt. And a worried Jack sticks close to Amy as they prepare for winter at the ranch.

episodes.title: Strength of Bonds
episodes.summary: As Thanksgiving approaches, Georgie puts her personal feelings about Peyton Westfield aside and convinces Amy to work with a high strung and dangerous jumping horse. Meanwhile, Jade returns from Texas for the holiday weekend and Tim is forced to admit why he was so adamant she accept the rodeo scholarship. Wyatt goes completely overboard trying to prove his affection for Georgie and it lands them in a comical but compromising situation. And when Lou can't make it home for Thanksgiving, Jack and Lisa try to save tradition by coercing a secret family recipe out of her.

episodes.title: A Place to Call Home
episodes.summary: A training accident results in a serious injury and Georgie feels conflicted when an unlikely ally arrives at Heartland to show support.

episodes.title: Doubt
episodes.summary: In the aftermath of a vicious viral video, Georgie reconsiders her future in show jumping… and in Hudson. Meanwhile, Amy and Ty are of differing opinions about what to do with their new land. A lucrative business opportunity puts Jack, Mitch and Tim at odds. And Lou struggles with how to support her daughter through a difficult time.

episodes.title: Naming Day
episodes.summary: In the days leading up to baby Lyndy's naming ceremony, the members of the Heartland family find themselves keeping secrets from each other. Without Amy's knowledge, Ty enlists Caleb's help in fulfilling a long-held promise to himself. Amy works with Spartan in secret on something she hopes will make her daughter's day truly memorable. And when Val approaches her with yet another offer, Georgie has to make an important decision as she prepares for the Fall Finale. Meanwhile, Jack comes to a startling realization and Tim gets news that he finds hard to share.

episodes.title: Dare to Dream
episodes.summary: Amy and Ty face parenting problems, but healing a wild mare and her foal may help them find a solution. Meanwhile, Lou comes home with a big decision to make, but news about Mitch steals her focus. And Georgie struggles to overcome past fears when she's asked to do an interview for an equestrian magazine. Then, while Tim thinks about the next step in his relationship, Jack and Lisa could face future problems in theirs.

episodes.title: Hearts Run Free
episodes.summary: Amy and Ty plan a romantic trip to Pike River, but Jack tags along to visit his old friend, Will Vernon. Meanwhile, Georgie trains hard with Phoenix to prove to a potential coach that they're a great team, and Lou wavers on her decision regarding Maggie's Diner in New York City. And Tim makes a spur of the moment decision causing tension between him and Jack.

episodes.title: Just Breathe
episodes.summary: Ty is asked to mentor a troubled kid, but finding common ground proves harder than he expected. Meanwhile, Lou organizes a horse yoga retreat at the Dude Ranch, but she is taken by surprise when she learns who the instructor is and this subsequently leads to hijinks between Georgie and Wyatt. And as Amy works with a restless yoga horse she learns the real reason her dad is so keen on helping Jack and Ty build a treehouse for Lyndy.

episodes.title: Risk and Reward
episodes.summary: Amy and Ty take Lyndy on her first camping trip, but things don't go as planned when they find an injured animal along the way. Meanwhile, when Jade takes a bad fall in a bronc riding accident, Tim and Georgie must convince her to see a doctor before she ends up in a dangerous situation. And when Georgie starts working with her new coach, the advice she is given leaves her questioning her priorities. At the same time, Tim makes a nuisance of himself in his new home, causing Jack to call him out. Caleb is back to stir things up with Tim, but isn't that what we expect?

episodes.title: Change of Heart
episodes.summary: Georgie enlists Wyatt's help in reuniting a famous trick rider with her long-lost horse. Meanwhile, when Clint brings Luke back to Heartland it's up to Amy and Ty to find a way to connect with him. And when Tim crosses a line at Heartland, Jack finally loses his patience with his new housemate.

episodes.title: Diamond in the Rough
episodes.summary: When the new manager at Fairfield comes to them with an unusual concern, Amy and Ty find themselves at odds about how best to treat her horse. Meanwhile, Lou and Peter don't see eye to eye when Georgie is offered a life-changing opportunity. And Jack and Mitch disagree on the best recipe for success at an important business meeting.

episodes.title: Running Scared
episodes.summary: Amy and Tim organize a team penning event for the family, but Tim manages to turn it into a town spectacle.

episodes.title: Stress Fractures
episodes.summary: Lou returns to Heartland with an unconventional idea to attract guests to the Dude Ranch.

episodes.title: Long Road Back
episodes.summary: Amy and Ty work together to treat a doped racehorse, but when it turns into a race against the clock Amy looks to an unexpected source for help.

episodes.title: All Hearts Lead Home
episodes.summary: After receiving tragic news, the family finds ways to cope with their grief.

episodes.title: Snakes and Ladders
episodes.summary: A disgruntled horse owner causes problems for Ty and Amy's business, and they find themselves at odds about taking him on as a client.

episodes.title: Wild One
episodes.summary: Amy is hired to gentle one of the wild horses, but his temperament may prove impossible to work with.

episodes.title: Rearview Mirror
episodes.summary: Jack is faced with painful memories from his past, and the family is at a loss for how to help him.

episodes.title: The Eye of the Storm
episodes.summary: A dangerous windstorm wreaks havoc on Hudson.

episodes.title: Fairytale
episodes.summary: Amy and Ty worry about the impact a surprise visitor will have on Luke.

episodes.title: A Time to Remember
episodes.summary: Georgie's graduation has finally arrived, but so has a mysterious figure from her past.

episodes.title: The Art of Trust
episodes.summary: Amy is asked to spend time at an art retreat to work with an artist's allegedly traumatized horse.

episodes.title: Legacy
episodes.summary: Tim is roped into organizing an important rodeo when an old flame blows back into Hudson asking for his help.

episodes.title: Fight or Flight
episodes.summary: Amy and Ty get some unexpected news about Luke just as Amy has to face an upsetting truth about Spartan. Meanwhile, as Ty deals with an influx of injured animals, Lou thinks she knows what's causing the problem, but Tim warns her against risking her mayoral campaign on a dangerous theory. And while Jack helps Luke with a secret project, Georgie works on finding a way to help Amy's dilemma with Spartan, but her motives may not be entirely selfless.

episodes.title: The Passing of the Torch
episodes.summary: When fears of holding on or letting go grip the family, they look to each other for support through dangerous challenges.

episodes.title: Keep Me in Your Heart
episodes.summary: The past year has brought unexpected change to the Heartland family. While Amy deals with a major upheaval in her life, Lou copes with the reality of being the mayor of Hudson, and Georgie revisits her dream of the Olympics.

episodes.title: The Last Goodbye
episodes.summary: Amy must face a difficult truth when her efforts to help a young girl form a connection with her new horse takes an unexpected turn. Meanwhile, Lou faces harsh criticism as mayor, and a cattle drive brings up difficult memories for Jack.

episodes.title: Making Amends
episodes.summary: Amy grudgingly helps Ty's mother Lily with a traumatized racehorse. Lou gets into even more hot water when she tries to sell Hudson as a "must see" tourist destination.

episodes.title: Through the Smoke
episodes.summary: Disaster strikes Hudson when a train derails and causes an explosion that threatens the town; a wild fire quickly spreads toward the rodeo grounds and, Amy rushes to save the abandoned horses there.

episodes.title: Outsiders
episodes.summary: The wild, black stallion that Amy rehomed from Will's ranch is brutally forced out of the herd by the new leader; leaving Amy to track down the injured horse and nurse him back to health.

episodes.title: The New Normal
episodes.summary: A group of wild horses need new homes; Amy must get back to her Miracle Girl roots and host her first horse clinic in over a year.

episodes.title: Courage
episodes.summary: Tim seeks out help from an unlikely person when he finds himself competing in a polo match; Amy is concerned her daughter isn't adjusting well to her new reality; she makes a decision that worries Jack.

episodes.title: Changing Gears
episodes.summary: Caleb finds a memento from the past that he thinks will have special meaning for Amy; surprisingly, it's Jack who has some mixed emotions stirred up by the gift.

episodes.title: Find Me in the Dark
episodes.summary: Quinn's wealthy father arrives at Heartland with a life-changing proposition for both Amy and his son.

episodes.title: Staying the Course
episodes.summary: Amy works with a challenging horse to help a friend of Clint's; she also revives a dream to rebuild the jumping course that she and Spartan practiced on so many years ago.

episodes.title: Moving Toward the Light
episodes.summary: Amy must help a skeptical performer, and her pair of matched liberty horses work together again. Jack unexpectedly buys Mitch's herd of cattle. Tim returns from his trip with a surprise for everyone.

episodes.title: Runaway
episodes.summary: A wild stallion escapes from Sam's ranch during a burglary and Amy will stop at nothing to find him; Lisa's latest business investment is at risk; Tim and Jessica adjust to life back at Heartland.

episodes.title: Bad Moon Rising
episodes.summary: Amy discovers a teen with a gift for horses at Cooper's therapy centre, Lou is pressured to shut the centre down over recent break-ins and Lisa has Jack install a security system with Parker's "help".

episodes.title: Sins of the Father
episodes.summary: After a break-in at Heartland, unwelcome memories of his father flood Jack, Amy and Logan work with a wild horse, and Tim and Parker form an unlikely duo to find the stolen goods.

episodes.title: Blood and Water
episodes.summary: Amy and Shadow find themselves in jeopardy on a cattle drive. Lou feels overlooked when the issue of Heartland Beef's succession plan is raised. Parker and Katie babysit Lyndy and things go awry.

episodes.title: Happy Ever After
episodes.summary: Tim and Jessica's attempt to throw a "small party" snowballs. Lou struggles to hide a revived past relationship from the family. Amy and Logan continue to work with the wild horse.

episodes.title: Bluebird
episodes.summary: The man who shot Ty returns to Hudson and Amy and the rest of the family grapple with how to react. Jessica enlists Katie and Parker's help to deal with a demanding Dude Ranch guest while Lou is away.

episodes.title: Brand New Day
episodes.summary: Hudson hosts a lumberjack competition and Amy must retrain a Clydesdale and his owner to compete in the draft horse race. Tim throws his hat in the ring. Lou tries to avoid a date with Fred Garland.

episodes.title: The Long Game
episodes.summary: Amy enters Spartan into an endurance race after realizing he's not ready to retire, Jack is set on gentling an unbroke horse despite the danger, and Lou and Katie reveal hidden feelings while camping.

episodes.title: Leaving a Legacy
episodes.summary: Amy debates what to do when she receives money from an unexpected source. Lisa's racing plans are in jeopardy after an accident. Tim worries when Jessica is hiding something. Lou makes a big decision.

episodes.title: Something's Got to Give
episodes.summary: After another Miracle Girl moment, Amy reconsiders her role at the Youth Centre. Jack misses Lisa, especially after Tim and Jessica are forced to move into the house.

episodes.title: Changes
episodes.summary: Amy's decision to work with Peyton Westfield's horse upsets Logan. Jack helps Katie find her own path. Lou has to come through for Rick.

episodes.title: On the Ropes
episodes.summary: Amy and Caleb train one of Sam's rescue horses to be a roping horse. Jack and Tim disagree about Blue's future. Katie and Logan go river rafting, and end up on a bigger adventure than they expected.

episodes.title: Spark to Flame
episodes.summary: Amy is surprised to learn Finn has returned to town. Jack and Tim win Hudson's Entrepreneur of the Year Award, which leads to unexpected problems for Lou and the arrival of someone from Tim's past.

episodes.title: Higher Ground
episodes.summary: When flood evacuees come to Hudson, Amy works with a traumatized horse. Jack and Lisa help a young couple. Tim connects with an evacuee. Rick steps up in Lou's absence.

episodes.title: Into the Wild
episodes.summary: Amy helps a unique animal from an abandoned zoo. Tim joins Jessica in New York for her art show, while trying to fix a past mistake. Jack and Lisa work through difficulties in their relationship.

episodes.title: Vigil
episodes.summary: A storm leads to a sad goodbye and the return of some old friends. Amy thinks her worst fears about Finn have come true until she learns about his past. Lou reads Katie's journal without permission.

episodes.title: Running Down a Dream
episodes.summary: Amy teaches Lyndy how to barrel race. Logan's father arrives at Heartland. Jessica seeks distraction from a disappointment in New York. Katie gets her ears pierced, causing a fight with Lou.

episodes.title: True Colours, New Tricks
episodes.summary: Amy leads an overnight trail ride to help with Jessica's new photography job. On the ride, Amy and Jack have a disagreement about Finn. Lou's latest mayoral event upsets Rick.

episodes.title: Lurking in the Shadows
episodes.summary: Amy and Lou go on a road trip to stop a Miracle Girl imposter. Tim puts on a rodeo school showcase, but a series of mysterious events threaten the show. Amy questions if she should visit Finn.

episodes.title: Head Over Heels
episodes.summary: Amy agrees to let Logan take the lead with a new client horse. A furious Tim goes after the person responsible for Jack's accident. Lou struggles to reconnect with Katie.

episodes.title: Memory
episodes.summary: A surprise visitor causes Amy to see Finn differently. A weekend trip to the cabin has Jack struggling with his past, while Katie finally opens up. Lou and Peter's dinner party doesn't go as planned.

episodes.title: Striking a Balance
episodes.summary: Amy helps Lisa with Platinum Bow. Tim has a difficult visit with Shane. Katie leads a strike at Maggie's. Jack reconnects with his country music roots.

episodes.title: Learning to Fly
episodes.summary: Amy helps Georgie rediscover her passion for showjumping. Lou's surprised when Peter announces he's moving to Heartland. A Winter Fair allows Tim to help Jessica and his rodeo school.

episodes.title: A Light in the Dark
episodes.summary: Jack faces the truth about his rift with Al Cotter. Lou and Peter take the next step in their relationship. Georgie makes a decision about her future, while Amy sees her own future in a new light.

episodes.title: The Path Less Traveled
episodes.summary: Amy is surprised when a very pregnant Mallory shows up at the ranch with a wild horse. Jack and Tim face new competition, and Lou grapples with a familiar opponent in her campaign to be re-elected.

episodes.title: Taking the Reins
episodes.summary: Amy and Jack retrain Edwin's horse for carriage racing, bringing Amy and Edwin closer. Logan takes on his first client horse. Election night arrives for Lou just as the family faces a difficult loss.

episodes.title: The Heart Wants
episodes.summary: Amy helps Caleb with his son's pony. Lou and Jessica start a new venture, while Katie tries a risky new hobby. Logan takes a big step in his relationship with Miley, but then disaster strikes.

episodes.title: A Piece Apart
episodes.summary: Amy must deal with Lyndy's sudden fear of horses. Logan blames himself for Miley's accident. Tim enlists the family to make Shane's return to Heartland perfect while Katie struggles with a friendship.

episodes.title: How to Say Goodbye
episodes.summary: Amy and Jack train Blue for a competition. Lisa deals with a difficult loss. Lou lets Jessica down in their partnership for the gallery. Katie secretly buys a used dirt bike.

episodes.title: Heat of the Moment
episodes.summary: At the competition, Amy has a run in with an old friend that leads to heartache. Jack and Lisa prove they can be adventurous. Katie stands up for herself when Ellie and Brandon push her too far.

episodes.title: Unknown Caller
episodes.summary: Lou's forced to face the reason for her insomnia. Amy works with a new client who has a surprising connection to Katie. Jack wins over a prickly dude ranch guest.

episodes.title: Harmony
episodes.summary: Amy helps a vaulting team ahead of a big competition. Caleb struggles with a tough decision about Carson. Logan realizes where his future lies. Lou and Jessica face a stressful gallery opening.

episodes.title: Fear is a Liar
episodes.summary: Amy and Nathan retrain his horse. Tim navigates new family dynamics when Miranda shows up early to help with Shane and Chloe's wedding. Jessica has to heal a rift with Jack.

episodes.title: Just the Beginning
episodes.summary: An accident puts Shane's wedding in jeopardy. Nathan tries to make amends with Amy while helping his traumatized horse. Heartland Beef faces an uncertain future. Katie finds a new side of herself.

episodes.title: True Grit
episodes.summary: Heartland struggles with competition from Pryce Beef just as Amy agrees to help Nathan Pryce in a sheepdog competition. Lou, Jack and Tim are feeling the strain as a water shortage is on the horizon.

episodes.title: Bird's Eye View
episodes.summary: Caleb returns to help Amy with a mysterious Icelandic horse while weather conditions force Lou to build a firebreak with the enemy – Nathan Pryce.

episodes.title: You Can Lead a Horse to Water
episodes.summary: The family faces the hard reality of a drought at Heartland and the hunt is on to find the best spot to build a new well. Meanwhile Katie worries about her grandfather's health.

episodes.title: Into the Unknown
episodes.summary: The weight of the Hudson rumour mill leads Jack to make a surprising decision… While Amy works with a polo pony and sees a new side of Nathan in the process.

episodes.title: Fork in the Road
episodes.summary: The whole family heads to the Hudson Rodeo. Emotions run high at the barn dance after Amy helps Nathan deal with a family emergency.

episodes.title: Sisters
episodes.summary: Lou, Amy and Lisa head to Vancouver for a girls' trip. Lisa is caught in the middle when truths are revealed between sisters that could threaten to tear them apart.

episodes.title: World on a String
episodes.summary: Amy works with a unique client whose sanctuary is at risk of closure while a secret Katie's been keeping is revealed and shocks Lou.

episodes.title: Throwing Your Hat in the Ring
episodes.summary: Tensions boil over when Heartland and Pryce Beef face off at the Hudson Farmer's Market and Shane makes a surprise visit.

episodes.title: Leave No Trace
episodes.summary: Jack and Tim try to mend fences with Nathan on a fishing trip. Amy and Caleb save a horse in distress while Lou finds herself in a dangerous situation...

episodes.title: Open House
episodes.summary: Heartland hosts an Open House to bring the family and the community together – along with some old and new friends…

episodes.title: Risk Everything
episodes.summary: A raging wildfire threatens the ranch forcing the Heartland family to evacuate. But when a pregnant mare is trapped in the fire's path, Amy risks everything to try and save her.

episodes.title: Two Can Keep a Secret
episodes.summary: Amy must deal with the fallout when Lyndy's first 4-H show goes awry. Meanwhile Katie does something unexpected with Dodger.

episodes.title: Ghosts
episodes.summary: When Amy returns to Pike River with Nathan to work with Search and Rescue horses, she's confronted with memories of Ty. While Lou and Gracie track down a wolf, Jack finds his new ranch hand.

episodes.title: Braving the Wilderness
episodes.summary: As Amy and Ashley search the forest for the downed plane, Caleb and Nathan fight to survive the wilderness – and each other. Jack and Lisa organize an old-fashioned haying.

episodes.title: Suspicious Minds
episodes.summary: Amy's working with an Olympian's horse when Spartan's health suddenly declines. After Amy's high-profile client questions Amy's integrity, rumours threaten her reputation as a horse trainer.

episodes.title: Under the Lights
episodes.summary: The whole family heads to the Hudson Rodeo where Amy puts everything on the line to save her reputation. Katie proves herself at her first big Hudson Wilds Flag Team performance.

episodes.title: Fall Down, Get Back Up
episodes.summary: When Amy helps an old friend of Nathan's overcome his fear of riding a horse for his wedding day, she's caught wondering what the future holds for her. Meanwhile Dex must prove himself to Jack.

episodes.title: Lost and Found
episodes.summary: When Jack's called away to help a friend, Lou takes the lead on a cattle drive, but things don't go as planned. As Lisa reunites with her sister Tammy, Amy's feeling disconnected from Nathan.

episodes.title: Revenge
episodes.summary: While Amy secretly works with Gracie's new horse, Lou and Jack are determined to catch the rustlers and Dex confronts his past, and Georgie returns to Heartland.

episodes.title: Forgiveness
episodes.summary: Georgie comes to terms with Phoenix's new reality, and the identity of the rustlers is revealed. Amy and the rest of the Heartland family are left with difficult decisions to make about their futures.
